name: winui
description: Agents and skills for WinUI 3 app development. Create new WinUI 3 desktop apps, convert from other frameworks to WinUI 3, or add features to existing WinUI 3 applications.

interface.shortDescription: Build, package, and ship WinUI 3 desktop apps.
interface.longDescription: End-to-end WinUI 3 development for AI agents — scaffold projects, design XAML with Fluent UI and accessibility, build and diagnose with a real toolchain, automate UI tests, run code reviews, migrate from WPF, and package signed MSIX installers. Each skill is paired with purpose-built tools so the agent fetches just what it needs.
defaultPrompt: Create a new WinUI 3 app with MVVM.
Build and run the WinUI 3 project in this folder and fix any errors.
Migrate this WPF app to WinUI 3.
Package this WinUI 3 app as a signed MSIX.
